description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles the display and management of test case data and test suite/test project hierarchies, including searching, displaying, and interacting with test case entities within the system.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing a test project, used to manage test project data, options, and related functionalities.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case entities, including retrieval of test case details, versions, and related data.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class used to manage platform-specific data related to test cases within a test project.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: Class for managing code tracking integration, links, and interface related to test projects.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Helper class defining input parameter types for request processing.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, performing validation and setting up environment parameters for further processing.

methods.name: initializeEnv
methods.description: Sets up the environment, user grants, interface variables, and configurations needed for the script's operation.

methods.name: systemWideTestCaseSearch
methods.description: Performs a search for test cases across test projects based on user input, aiding in test case selection.

methods.name: getSettingFromFormNameSpace
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration settings from session or request namespaces.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Handles the display and interaction logic for individual test cases, including version management and related data display.
